Quality, Compassionate Treatment
August 29, 2022

Challenges related to drug and alcohol addiction touch the lives of millions of Americans and their families every year. Countless studies have shown that addiction knows no bounds. Age, race, religion, economic standing, or employment status provide immunity from the dangerous and potentially fatal consequences of drug and alcohol use disorders. Seeking help at a Northern California substance abuse detox program in Fremont, CA, can help you achieve and maintain lasting sobriety.
Substance Abuse in Fremont, CA

The city of Fremont, CA, is located in the East Bay region of the Bay Area within Alameda County. As the fourth most populous city in the Bay area, Fremont is home to just over 230,000 people. Fremont is also the closest East Bay city to California’s famous Silicon Valley network of businesses; therefore, the Freemont area has a strong technology industry presence.
Since the 1980 US census, the population in Fremont, CA, has nearly doubled.

Despite its beautiful location in San Francisco Bay area, Fremont and its surrounding areas experience many of the same complexities and challenges related to addiction that plague many other areas, especially larger metropolitan areas, of the state of California. This includes high levels of alcohol and opioid abuse rates. Unfortunately, substance abuse rates in the Fremont area remain high.

According to a recent study from the National Institute on Drug Use and Health, approximately 9.5% of Fremont residents over the age of 12 reported using illicit drugs in the past 30 days. This statistic is notably higher than the national average of 8.2%. Other research reports show that the Bay Area, and California as a whole, see the same ongoing rise of opioid-related deaths occurring due to heroin, prescription opioid, and fentanyl overdose.
What Types of Treatment Are Available in Fremont, CA?

Achieving recovery from drug or alcohol addiction requires seeking support and help from an addiction treatment program in Fremont. Addictions to drugs such as prescription painkillers, heroin, alcohol, and benzodiazepines are challenging to break independently. In fact, choosing to quit many of these drugs “cold turkey,” without the help and support of medically assisted detox and addiction therapy, can lead to dangerous and potentially fatal consequences.

When you stop using alcohol or taking opioid drugs, powerful, sometimes overwhelming symptoms call withdrawal symptoms quickly occur. In some instances, withdrawal symptoms can begin as few as six hours after your last dose or drink. Depending on the severity of your addiction, safely detoxing may require comprehensive medical support to help you manage the intensity and severity of your detox symptoms.
At Mariana Harbor Detox near Fremont, CA, we offer a range of drug and alcohol detox and addiction treatment programs to help you achieve and maintain lasting sobriety.
Drug and Alcohol Detox

Detox, or detoxification, is a critical first step towards achieving sobriety for many who begin an addiction treatment program. For someone with an addiction to opioids and alcohol, detoxing in a safe, medically supervised environment is crucial due to the potentially dangerous withdrawal symptoms that can accompany seeking recovery from certain types of drugs.

In our medically supervised drug and alcohol detox programs in Fremont, CA, a skilled team of caring and compassionate medical and mental health providers will support and guide you throughout all stages of detox. Depending on your needs, support may include:
Monitoring your physical and psychological health.
Administering medications to help manage withdrawal symptoms.
Providing nutritional support as you focus on healing.
Inpatient treatment

Inpatient addiction treatment, sometimes called residential treatment, is the second step in a drug and alcohol treatment program at a Fremont, CA, rehab center. Although a crucial first step, detox is not a suitable alternative for comprehensive, evidence-based addiction therapy. Participating in a therapy program is necessary to help you understand more about the root causes of addiction. Therapy also provides an opportunity to learn and practice coping tools and skills you can learn when faced with relapse triggers after treatment ends.
Holistic therapies

In addition to detoxification services and evidence-based drug and alcohol addiction therapy, Mariana Harbor Detox in Fremont provides a wide range of holistic therapy services throughout your addiction treatment program. Holistic therapies are various therapeutic models used in conjunction with a traditional, evidence-based treatment program to provide a more “whole person” approach to addiction treatment.

Most holistic treatments are not considered standalone options for addiction treatment; rather, they are most effective when used as complementary therapies. Popular holistic addiction therapies include nutrition education, nature walks, yoga, and meditation. Incorporating holistic therapies into an evidence-based program often allows patients to develop healthy coping tools and lifestyle changes that can further promote ongoing health and wellness and relapse prevention.
What to Look for in a Fremont Rehab Center?

There are no effective cookie-cutter treatments for drug or alcohol addiction. Addiction is a disease, and like many similar illnesses, addiction affects everyone differently. Therefore, the most effective treatment programs are those that take the time to adequately assess each patient and develop treatment programs based on their unique treatment needs and goals. When researching addiction treatment in Fremont, there are several things you should consider in choosing the best rehab for you.

First, choose a program that develops individualized treatment plans. As noted above, successful addiction treatment occurs when therapeutic models and holistic treatment options are applied based on the patient’s needs, not the diagnosis. Therefore, the most effective plans are developed only after a comprehensive assessment and evaluation considering your current physical and mental health and previous treatment experiences.

It is crucial to consider the level of care and other services that you will need to effectively achieve sobriety. Suppose your addiction is such that detoxification services are a crucial first step. In that case, choosing a program that offers medically supervised detox is vital before helping you transition into the therapeutic portion of an addiction treatment program.

Comprehensive aftercare planning is another crucial element to look for in a Fremont rehab center. Addiction treatment does not end upon completing a primary addiction treatment program. Instead, successfully maintaining a lifetime of sobriety from drugs or alcohol requires an ongoing commitment to remaining healthy and substance free. Aftercare programs provide access to ongoing therapy, peer support groups, and other support tools you may need at various stages in your recovery journey.
